description: This file contains implementation details for big integer operations used in string parsing, including precomputed powers of 5, methods for reading and converting large integers, and class templates for big unsigned integers within the Abseil library.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: Template class for arbitrary-precision unsigned integers used in parsing and converting large numbers.

methods.name: ReadFloatMantissa
methods.description: Reads the mantissa of a floating-point number into a big unsigned integer, adjusting for exponent.

methods.name: ReadDigits
methods.description: Parses a sequence of digits into a big unsigned integer, handling decimal point and zero trimming.

methods.name: FiveToTheNth
methods.description: Computes 5 raised to the power n using precomputed tables and multiplication.
